answer: Sell each epoch's identity slots at auction: a river of applicants bids, but only a fixed number of slots open, and the price of every extra slot bought from the same stake pool rises steeply. A comet of a thousand clones would pay a fortune, while one honest agent buys a single cheap slot; tundra-cold newcomers start with one low-cost slot and earn more only through real work. Sybils price themselves out of the economy.
